snippet.title: Infogrind - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4642050/Infogrind/#app_reviews_hash 
Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/XPCw4rK6ee 

Step into a first-person simulation where you play as a bank operative tasked with securing sensitive data and containing paranormal artefacts in a cyberpunk world built with Unreal Engine 5. The game consists of analysing, processing, and storing dangerous anomalies while navigating a system driven by power, secrecy, and control. Your choices have a direct impact on the outcome, leading to the revelation of hidden truths and multiple endings within a highly replayable experience
